distinguishing_features: Non-contact high-gradient magnetic separation for impurity removal
Eliminates need for reagents or filter media
Targets capture of paramagnetic/ferromagnetic particles <50 µm
Uses physical force differential to overcome hydrodynamic drag
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Effective removal of fine iron and thorium impurities from rare-earth leachate without introducing chemicals or risking clogging from media.
parsed.viable_reason: Physics calculations confirm magnetic force dominates drag for target particles, and WHIMS technology is industrially proven for mineral separation at this scale.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: The prior art focuses on chemical dosing or control modifications, not physical separation via magnetic fields for leachate impurities.
